[The Dungeon, is a complex expansive subterranean labyrinth located under and beneath Orario, is the only place in the world that has a dungeon and many people of different Races gather from across the world to explore it. The Dungeon is seemingly alive, spawning monsters from the walls and ceilings, and repairing itself on its own. It has an immense hatred of the Gods, instigating room seal-offs and hazardous monster spawnings upon their detection. The Dungeon is vast, with the floors becoming progressively larger the deeper it gets. It takes at least five days for a party to reach the 50th floor. While the upper floors can be soloed or done with a pair, starting from the middle floors, one must create a party or risk death. Progressively escalating in danger, its depths serve as a challenging frontier for adventurers seeking experience, treasures, and energy-yielding crystal shards left by slain beasts.]

[Orario: Also known as Labyrinth City Orario, here is the 'The Dungeon', shaped like a perfect circle, the city is surrounded by a fortress wall designed to fend off external threats. In the heart of the city stands Babel, a tower that reaches the heavens and serves as a gateway to the Dungeon. Babel's impressive size and grandeur make it the most prominent landmark in Orario. Its architectural style is primarily European-like, featuring a combination of cobblestone streets, stone walls, and buildings made from wood, brick, and plaster. Orario's main industry revolves around magic stones and spoils brought from the dungeon. Orario draws all kinds of adventurers from all races, with the promise of riches and glory through the exploration of the dungeon.]

[Gods. They are divine beings who have descended from heaven in pursuit of amusement and fresh experiences. Despite their inherent omnipotence, divine powers are forbidden in the lower realm, making them similar to ordinary people. It manifests itself physically in a form similar to a tattoo as a mass of text with all its characteristics detailed, as well as the corresponding familia's emblem, completely necessary to level up and be a adventurer.]
